svg.text: ROYAL SCIBBLES
Detailed UX flow · Clash Royale–led graybox kit
106 distinct mobile states · 663 labeled control routes · 38 system branches · 20 wireframe sheets
01 CORE LOOP
Choose an 8-card deck → spend 1 ticket on match start → deploy from a 4-card hand using regenerating
elixir → win trophies, Gold and a chest → unlock the chest → collect cards → spend Gold + copies to
upgrade.
02 HOW TO READ / TEST
Dark filled buttons are primary actions. Each control has a numbered badge; the adjacent route rail names
its exact destination. State rules sit outside the phone. Use the clickable HTML preview to walk any
route; simulated match and timer outcomes sit outside the UI.
GOLD / SOFT CURRENCY
Earn: battles, chests, quests, events, clan donations. Spend: card upgrades. Show cost, owned balance,
deficit and new balance before confirmation. Missing Gold routes to earning options or an explicitly
priced Gem exchange. No silent substitution.
GEMS / HARD CURRENCY
Earn in configured rewards or buy from the platform store. Spend: ticket refills, chest speedups and Gold
exchanges. Confirm amount and resulting balance. Preserve original intent after a purchase; do not
automatically spend newly bought Gems.
TICKETS / GAMEPLAY ENTRY
Example: 5 maximum, 1 ticket per 30 minutes, 1 per ranked/event match. Reserve in queue; consume on match
start. Cancel or timeout releases reservation. Server-cancelled match refunds once. Reward grants may
overflow cap; regeneration pauses at/above cap. Training is free.
CHESTS / TIME-BASED UNLOCK
Example: four slots, one active timer, Silver Chest takes 3 hours. Win → locked → start timer → unlocking
→ ready → reveal → collected. Gems may finish early after confirmation. Full slots require explicit
play-without-chest consent. Guaranteed event chests may open instantly or go to Inbox.
FTUE / FIRST VALUE
One free practice duel → instant starter chest → card copies → Gold upgrade → grant full tickets → normal
hub. Introduce one mechanic at a time. Persist checkpoint; all retries free. No monetization gates during
teaching.
LIVE OPS / PLAYER LIFECYCLE
Upcoming → eligible/locked → active → scoring → claimable milestones → results pending → final reward →
claim deadline → Inbox. Include free and premium pass tracks, late-match grace, ties, daily claims and
returner rewards.
LIVE OPS / STUDIO WORKFLOW
Brief owner → audience + gates → scoring + economy budget → schedule in UTC → config + localized copy → QA
boundary cases → staging rehearsal → publish/version lock → monitor entry/claims/grants → close +
reconcile → analyze. Rollback stops new entry and preserves earned rewards; compensation uses a
deduplicated grant.
REUSE / SWAP THE CORE
Brawl-style: replace deck/arena with hero + action HUD. Kingshot-style: replace battle with build/march
queues. Candy-style: replace hand/elixir with board/moves and tickets with lives. Tennis-style: replace
deck with gear and arena with court. Keep resource, reward, claim, payment and recovery contracts.
CONFIGURATION / BEFORE A TEST
Set ticket cap/regeneration/refill price; chest count/timers/reward table; card copy and Gold costs;
trophy gates; event start/end/grace/claim dates; scoring caps; tie policy; pass price; notification
frequency; account requirements. Sample numbers in these screens are not balance recommendations.
DELIVERY / CURRENT LIMIT
The native Figma API is blocked by the Starter tool limit. These updated sheets are imported as vector
trees, with visible routes. Native prototype wiring is not present. The supplied HTML preview is clickable
and all target IDs are validated. Text behavior in Figma depends on SVG import.
PRIMARY REFERENCE

Supercell: Gems & Gold; Clash Royale April 2025 update. Current Clash Royale removed chest timers and queues in 2025. This kit deliberately combines classic chest progression with your requested ticket system.
October 20, 2026 · Royal Scibbles is a generic product concept, not a recreation of current Clash Royale.
